note: WHICH REALIZATION-CHOICES FILE BELONGS TO WHICH KNOWLEDGE OBJECT. Added 13 October 2026. This is a REALIZER's input, not knowledge: nothing here is authored learning design, and nothing here is read by selection or derivation. It exists because the choices were looked up by Learning Goal — the builder read `a04-realization-choices.json` because the goal was A04 — while every line that file closes belongs to the possession game form (`c:restated:GF2:...`) or to the game itself (`game::...`), not to the goal. So Stay Organized and Defend 1v1, which select the same game form, had no choices to realize with and Beat Defenders 1v1 had a file named after it. The key is the knowledge object, spelled the way the contract corpus spells it (the library prefix and the restated:/blind: kind removed, upper case). A GAME FORM must have an entry or the builder refuses at realization, saying a set-up decision has not been made; any other contracted object MAY have one, and its choices are added to the game form's. The old filename is kept because the frozen Golden Case, the freezer and five test files read it by that name; renaming it would move nothing a coach sees. Stage B2 replaces most of these entries with justified defaults.
